title: Supplier net-rate increase
what: Bedbank C raised its net rates in Spain from 15 Jun 2026; selling prices did not move
evidence: Margin rate on Bedbank C x Spain 8.5% -> 2.2%; bookings/day 10.5 -> 10.4
recommendation: Re-route Spain demand to Direct contracts / Bedbank B where cheaper; renegotiate or raise sell rates +5% on affected hotels
follow_up: Daily margin rate on Bedbank C x Spain back above 7%

title: Large API partner moved to a competitor
what: API-002 (top partner) ramped down from 7 Sep and stopped on 14 Sep 2026
evidence: API-002 bookings/day 10 -> 0; it explains 55% of the API channel drop
recommendation: Account review with the partner: compare our rates on its top 50 hotels, offer a targeted tier rather than a blanket discount
follow_up: Weekly volume of API-002; win-back offer within 2 weeks

title: Currency effect (real TRY depreciation, ECB rates)
what: Turkish partners pay in TRY; the lira lost value against the euro (ECB reference rates)
evidence: TRY -12% vs EUR (Oct 26 vs Oct 25). Sep-Oct YoY: bookings +16%, sales in TRY +35%, in EUR +18%; margin rate 6.1% vs 8.2% in euro markets
recommendation: Refresh TRY price lists weekly (not monthly) or quote in EUR/USD; report the market at constant FX
follow_up: Constant-FX sales line in the daily report

title: Source-market holiday (UAE)
what: Bookings from the UAE jump before the Eid al-Adha holiday (late May 2026)
evidence: Bookings/day +93% vs the previous 4 weeks; same holiday in 2025 (early June): +64%
recommendation: Normal seasonality, not an anomaly: align comparisons on the holiday calendar; secure allotments in Turkey/UAE destinations 6 weeks ahead
follow_up: Holiday calendar added to the alert baseline

title: Cancellation spike at one destination (Greece)
what: A local event (e.g. severe weather) triggered cancellations for mid-August stays
recommendation: Offer re-booking to other islands/dates before refund; check supplier cancellation terms (who bears the cost); no price action
follow_up: Re-booking rate of cancelled Greek stays

title: Price-match requests
what: Partners report lower competitor prices; each request is checked like-for-like
recommendation: Keep the margin floor; publish the checklist to partners to cut invalid requests
